scope: Exact saved actual fans verify necessary cheap-hull and contracted ranks. Socle and point columns contrast core independence with rank saturation. Exhaustive box ranks of a nonuniform quadric point ideal and independent free-prefix filtering support the uniform oversampling proof. Diagonal algebras check sharp worst-case scanning despite three initials. Polynomial division checks hypersurface box dimensions. Finite represented transversal direct sums verify the product identity, not the published asymptotic lower construction. No unrestricted improvement, separating ideal family or novelty established.

uniform_results.scanning_parameter: For fixed d, the largest nonsaturating anchored box volume s and worst free-prefix completion rank M obey 1+s/d^d<=M<=1+(d+1)^d*s, allowing infinity.
uniform_results.finiteness: Uniform free-prefix completion is finite exactly when every coordinate separately is cyclic; the universal finite-case bound n^d is sharp in power.
uniform_results.whole_class_count: Every quotient with s=O_d(n) has g=O_d(n^(d-1)*log(n+1)^(d-1)), by constant oversampling and the existing ordered-prefix theorem. This has the generic sharp order, using the existing generic lower theorem.
uniform_results.nonuniform_infinite_class: Sufficiently generic n distinct points on an absolutely irreducible hypersurface of positive coordinate degrees d_i have rectangular rank saturation when n<=prod(d_i+1)-1. The characteristic-zero Fermat family has a four-term dependence.
uniform_results.enumeration_consequence: For d=3 this class has the existing oracle-enumeration bound O(n^3*L^2+n^(omega+2)*L^3), excluding coefficient bit costs.
uniform_results.cheap_hull_obstruction: Every actual q-wall has rank(L_q)<=n-1, and its image modulo the compulsory core has rank at most n-nu(q).
uniform_results.general_matroid_scope: A direct sum of two published Eppstein transversal lower families gives Omega(r^(8/3)) positive profiles on Theta(r) elements and rank 2r. Therefore the ordinary spatial k-set bound does not extend to arbitrary represented matroids.
